description: Full-Stack development focused on digitalizing business processes, frontend architecture, automation, and internal developer tooling.
extendedDescription:
As a Full-Stack Developer with a strong focus on Frontend, I design and build internal software solutions aimed at digitalizing and automating business processes. Beyond application development, I contribute to frontend architecture, engineering standards, and internal tooling, helping establish a consistent foundation for product development across the company.
I currently serve as the technical owner of the Health area, contributing to architectural decisions, development standards, and technical coordination while supporting and mentoring other developers.
achievements: **Frontend Architecture & Standardization** — Defined and standardized frontend architecture and development practices across internal applications, establishing a more consistent foundation for product development.
**Design System & Developer Tooling** — Helped establish a shared component library and developed CLI-based scaffolding and automation tools to accelerate development and reduce repetitive work.
**Technical Ownership** — Took technical ownership of the Health area, contributing to architecture decisions, development standards, implementation, and technical coordination.

**Business Automation & Full-Stack Development** — Built end-to-end solutions across frontend applications, APIs, databases, cloud services, and third-party integrations to digitalize and automate operational processes.

**Scraping & Process Optimization** — Designed and optimized worker-based, event-driven scraping systems, reducing execution times from minutes to seconds and improving the reliability of critical processes.
